chunks: Sa'd narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from 'Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Aban ibn 'Uthman, from Zurarah, from Abi 'Abd Allah عليه السلام, who said:
In salat al-khawf, for the Maghrib prayer, he leads the first group in one rak'ah, and they complete two rak'ahs; then he leads the latter group in two rak'ahs, and they complete one rak'ah.

key_terms.الْآخَرِينَ: the second group praying behind the Imam
key_terms.الْأَوَّلِينَ: the first group praying behind the Imam
key_terms.الْمَغْرِبُ: the Maghrib prayer specifically being discussed here
key_terms.صَلَاةُ الْخَوْفِ: the prayer performed under conditions of danger or fear
key_terms.يَقْضُونَ: they complete the remaining units of the prayer

ai.seo_question: How is the Maghrib prayer performed in salat al-khawf according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the ruling for salat al-khawf in the Maghrib prayer. It describes how the Imam divides the prayer between two groups in a manner that preserves both worship and security during conditions of fear.
